item.name: 02 - Authentication

request.description: Public. Creates a student account (status `active`) using the current model: `field` (an active `study_fields.id`, e.g. 9) and `specialization` (an active `specializations.id` under that field, e.g. 92 = Mechanical Engineering). The specialization must belong to the selected field, otherwise 422 `"User field or specialization is incorrect."`. Names are still accepted for backward compatibility. Values come from the Lookups endpoints. Expected: 201 with `data.user` and an access `token`. A 409 means the email is already registered.

request.description: Public list of published trainings with filters (specialization_id, skill_id, training_type, work_mode, paid, employment_possible, company_id, city, keyword). Training keyword search lives in the dedicated Search API: GET /api/v1/search/trainings?q=... Every training has ONE primary specialization (training_listings.specialization_id) exposed on each card as a specialization object; there is no training field filter, sort (newest/oldest/title/name/deadline/relevance) and pagination. Works without a token; a student token adds per-item is_saved. AUTHENTICATED STUDENTS: results are automatically restricted to published trainings whose specialization_id EXACTLY equals the student's own students.specialization_id. The student does not send any parameter for this and query parameters cannot override it; a student without a specialization receives an empty list (total=0). All other filters, sorting and pagination still apply on top of this restriction.

item.name: 09 - Manual Payment (Student)
item.description: Student side of the manual (bank transfer) lifecycle for an accepted paid training. Auth: student Bearer token ({{access_token}}). Lifecycle: the student transfers the fee to the owning company's bank_account (shown in the Accepted ledger), submits the transfer reference (POST .../payment) which creates/updates exactly one payments row as status "pending", and then reads the state (GET .../payment). The owning company verifies the transfer with 'Confirm Manual Payment', which promotes the pending row to "paid". Safe to run repeatedly: re-submitting for a pending row updates the reference on the same row and never duplicates it; once the row is paid, submitting again returns 409.
